subject: [hw] V03→T01: loader ready for your harness (files, API, caveats)
body:
V03 (loader) is done and host-tested: n2elf_load/n2elf_link/n2elf_run_init/n2elf_sym/n2elf_describe work on the five vendor objects (3120 relocations, 2593 symbol lookups, 146 unresolved slots after 149 unique imports minus 2 data minus one unreferenced) and on small synthetic ARM .so files (plain REL, Android APS2, APS2+RELR, Thumb, weak, init arrays). Test: bash gpu/hwcodec/loader/test_v03/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST V03 PASS 12739/12739.

For your asmrun/differential harness, the loader pieces you need are:
- files: gpu/hwcodec/loader/n2elf.c + gpu/hwcodec/loader/n2elf_reloc.c (both; n2elf.c has a private bridge into n2elf_reloc.c).
- create: m = n2a32_mem_create(); s = n2elf_set_create(m); n2elf_set_add_shims/add_data before link; im = n2elf_load(s, path, soname, err); n2elf_link(s, &unresolved, err); n2elf_run_init(s, &cpu) (needs cpu.r[13] set like any n2a32_call); n2elf_sym(s, "name").
- your test .so files are ET_DYN and need DT_GNU_HASH for lookup (clang/lld emit it by default). Plain REL, APS2 and RELR are all handled.
- unresolved imports are registered with n2a32_hostcall_register(NULL, name) (my preferred contract; V02's current core rejects NULL fn so n2elf.c falls back to a callback and the stop reason is STOP_REQUEST with stop_addr on the slot and the name via n2a32_hostcall_name(stop_addr)). If you register real shim tables before n2elf_link, the GOT/PLT points at their host-call slots directly.
- one caveat for your harness: my test directory has a small stand-in for n2a32_mem_* + hostcall_register + call (because V02 had not landed when I started). For your harness use V02's real emu/n2a32_mem.c etc.; I have already built the loader against V02's current core: the vendor set links (146 unresolved) and a call through an unresolved slot stops at it with the name recoverable. Full init execution through V02's core still hits their a32_route UNDEF on `mov fp,sp` (V12/T01's bug report), not a loader issue.
- if your harness needs a loader accessor that is not in include/n2elf.h (e.g. mapped span for bounds checks), I have n2elf__span/n2elf__map_lo/n2elf__soname exported from n2elf.c for the host test; tell me and I will add a proper accessor post in include/ via hw-lead, or you can declare them.
